title: Причина: предложение или существительное
description: Причина: предложение или существительное: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Сохранять причинное отношение при изменении структуры
notes: Because + подлежащее и глагол: because it rained.
Because of + именная группа: because of the rain.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: The match was postponed ___ the heavy rain.
exercises.explanation: Перед именной группой the heavy rain используется because of.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: because of / because.

public_payload.sentence: We stayed inside ___ it was raining.

exercises.editorial_answer: We stayed inside because it was raining.
exercises.explanation: It was raining — полная часть, требующая because.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Поездка заняла больше времени из-за снега.»
exercises.editorial_answer: The journey took longer because of the snow.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: The event was delayed because of the room was locked.

accepted: The event was delayed because the room was locked.

exercises.reference_answer: The event was delayed because the room was locked.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The event was delayed because of the room was locked.
exercises.editorial_answer: The event was delayed because the room was locked.
exercises.explanation: Перед полной частью с was нужен because без of.

public_payload.passage: The class started late because the main entrance was locked. A sign later described the delay as being because of bad weather. It had been raining, but the tutor explained that rain had not prevented entry: a missing key had. The corrected notice named the actual practical problem rather than using a cause that merely happened at the same time.

options.label: A decision to cancel every class.
A locked entrance and a missing key.

exercises.editorial_answer: A locked entrance and a missing key.
exercises.explanation: Преподаватель прямо отделил дождь от проблемы доступа.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: cause — причина; disruption — нарушение обычной работы; weather — погода; delay — задержка
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: cause — причина; disruption — нарушение обычной работы; weather — погода; delay — задержка.

public_payload.passage: The class started late because the main entrance was locked. A sign later described the delay as being because of bad weather. It had been raining, but the tutor explained that rain had not prevented entry: a missing key had. The corrected notice named the actual practical problem rather than using a cause that merely happened at the same time.

options.label: It named a coinciding event instead of the stated cause.
Because of can never be grammatical.
The class had actually started early.

exercises.editorial_answer: It named a coinciding event instead of the stated cause.
exercises.explanation: Грамматическая связка не исправляет неверно названную причину.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Which sentence uses because of correctly?

options.label: We waited because of the bus was late.
We waited because of it arrived late.
We waited because of the delay.

exercises.editorial_answer: We waited because of the delay.
exercises.explanation: The delay — именная группа после because of.
